$comment: Declares whether this module uses the shared inspect shell from digital-3d-shared-contracts. Read by scripts/check_viewer_sync.mjs. While adopted is false the check warns loudly on every build instead of failing, so adoption is deliberate rather than something that breaks a live site the day the control lands.
reason: Build script emits no per-part bounding boxes, which the shared shell needs for framing and the selection box, and its config uses asset/documents/provenance rather than ViewerConfig. Adoption means emitting the shared PartsDocument contract. See digital-3d-shared-contracts/VIEWER-ADOPTION.md.
